method: bun bench/perf-gate/rss-marathon.ts (pinned profiler): in-process AgentSession, 120 rounds x 3 tool calls, forced compaction every 20 rounds; baseline proxy = rssFirst10AvgMb, peak = VmHWM via /proc/self/status

notes: Catalog: 9.6MB models.json materialized at import (+56MB anon, zero JSC objects) -> split into per-provider JSON with static-require lazy loader; only looked-up providers materialize.

Remaining baseline drivers: pi-tui import (+30MB anon, spread across latex tables/tui core), agent-session tool+component registry (200k objects), first-prompt transient churn (~180MB watermark from 60-180KB tool payload strings and session persistence buffers).
Per-round growth ~2MB/round is allocator retention (smaps anon), not JSC heap (jscHeapSize ~65MB flat, object count flat); MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 shaves ~30MB; heap policy knobs (--smol) shave ~5%.

nextSteps: Lazy-load pi-tui latex tables and heavy editor submodules from the barrel (~10MB).
Incremental/session-scoped tool registry construction in agent-session (~60MB JS objects at import).
Stream tool outputs instead of whole-string payloads to cut transient watermark (~180MB on first turn).
Allocator-level: periodic Bun.gc(false) on turn end; investigate mimalloc purge behavior for anon retention.
